function.description: [EaaS E2E Operating Model — A3.3 Tendering Procedure] Manage the EaaS tendering process — from RFI/RFP response through to preferred bidder selection — with qualification criteria, scoring models, and negotiation strategy. Outputs: Tender qualification and bid/no-bid framework; RFP response structure and content guide; Evaluation scoring model; Preferred bidder negotiation playbook.
